jobs.title: Frontend Software Engineer (React)
jobs.description:
### **Who we are**

At Vandebron, **we're transforming the energy landscape**, steering away from the conventional to champion sustainability. Born in 2014, our journey began with Chapter 1, disrupting the market with a transparent platform connecting consumers directly to local, green energy producers.

Now, in Chapter 2, we are dedicated to ensuring **100% green energy availability - 100% of the time**. Think smart solutions - flexible use of wind and solar farms, Smart EV Charging, and efficient energy storage. No waiting around - we actively shape a sustainable future.

Good energy, smart solutions - that’s Vandebron.

### **Your impact**

As a React Developer, **you play a crucial role in strengthening the heart of Vandebron’s marketplace: our energy producers**. You’ll take **ownership of the front-end development of a brand-new producer engagement platform** - the primary digital touchpoint for our producers. This platform will provide radical transparency, meaningful data insights, and intuitive tools that help producers stay connected to Vandebron and actively participate in the energy transition.

Working closely with engineers, designers, and product stakeholders, you’ll turn complex requirements into elegant, scalable solutions - ensuring a high-quality user experience and a future-proof codebase.

In this role, you’ll be reporting to Aviv Hasson, Engineering Team Lead.

### **What you’ll do**

* **Build the new Producer Platform** by taking a leading role in front-end development, from early concepts to a production-ready, scalable React application.
* Develop and maintain high-quality products, **ensuring performance, reliability, and long-term maintainability**.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with software engineers, designers, and product stakeholders to solve complex technical and product challenges.
* Review code across the Digital team, contributing to a high standard of code quality and shared best practices.
* **Share knowledge** actively through our Guilds structure, helping raise the overall engineering bar across Vandebron.
* Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical discussions, and occasional check-ins.
* Drive your own growth, working closely with your manager to shape your technical and professional development.

### **What you bring**

* **4+ years of experience as a React software engineer**, with a strong foundation in modern web development.
* A strong product mindset - you care about the end-user experience and enjoy building products from scratch.
* **Experience working with TypeScript** in a production environment.
* Familiarity with testing frameworks and methodologies, ensuring reliable and robust software.
* A curiosity-driven mindset - you enjoy learning, improving, and staying up to date with new technologies.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, enabling you to work effectively across disciplines.

### **Why this role is a meaningful career move**

This role puts you **at the center of a high-impact product** that directly supports the producers powering the energy transition.

You’ll help shape a platform that gives producers more insight, control, and connection - while working in a scale-up environment where engineering quality, product thinking, and societal impact go hand in hand. You’ll have real ownership, technical influence, and the space to grow.

### **What’s in it for you**

* An annual bonus based on company performance
* 30 days of paid leave per year
* Additional paid time off, for life events (moving, wedding celebrations, enhanced parental leave), Liberation Day off every year and on top of that 2 extra days off per year: one for volunteering, one for choosing sustainable travel
* Work abroad for up to 6 weeks per year (max. 4 consecutive, including up to 4 weeks outside the EU)
* A possibility to have a sabbatical after 3 years
* €1,200 annual learning budget + unlimited access to L&D programs
* Strong focus on your well-being, with unlimited access to the mental health platform OpenUp
* A solid pension scheme
* Income protection through long-term illness insurance
* €50 net allowance per month for phone & WiFi
* A one-time €200 home office setup budget
* Discount on your Vandebron invoice
* A flexible hybrid setup between home and our carbon-neutral Amsterdam office
* Daily free, healthy, vegetarian lunches cooked in-house
* An NS Business Card if you live more than 10km from the office

### **Interested?**

If this role excites you, apply via this page.

Not convinced yet or still have questions? Feel free to reach out via jordreukers@vandebron.nl.

At Vandebron, we believe in diversity, inclusiveness, and equal career opportunities. Be your authentic self - and it’s totally okay with us if you don’t mention your gender or date of birth on your resume. We also care about your privacy and handle your data carefully. Under the GDPR, you are not required to provide us with any information about your health, race/nationality, or religion, and you may also omit your social security number (BSN) and passport photo from your job application documentation.

jobs.title: Junior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**As Junior Data Engineer, you’ll help build data products for the air‑cargo logistics industry by turning your academic knowledge into practical solutions, working closely with data engineers, software engineers, analysts, and consultants to solve real operational challenges.**

**Who we are**

We are Rotate. We help key players across the global air cargo and logistics industry make better commercial and strategic decisions. We provide cloud-based software and analytics, world-leading market data, and data-driven strategy consulting. Our clients include top-tier airlines, airports, freight forwarders, governments, shippers, investors, and other industry stakeholders.

Founded in 2022 by a core team of former aviation strategy consultants, Rotate has grown rapidly. We now have offices in the Netherlands and Malaysia and a diverse team of around 50 professionals, including strategy consultants, data scientists, software developers, and data engineers. Demand for our work continues to grow strongly, and we are therefore looking for talented data engineers to strengthen our team.

**What you’ll do**

Rotate provides a online SaaS platform containing 3 main products, each of these products is developed and maintained by a core team with a mixed skillset. As a junior data engineer you will join a product team which is a collection of data engineers, software developers, customer succes consultants and business people with every skillset that is needed to keep a complex b2b system going. Your tasks are to:

* maintain and improve current data pipelines
* onboard new clients and data sets
* extend and improve the current functionality of the tools
* work with current and new clients to help understand the usage of the tool
* work in a scrum team responsible for keeping a SaaS product going
* understand data and how it effects operations and processing

In the team you will learn the ins and outs of the air cargo industry. Next to domain knowledge you will also work on your own skillset as a data engineer with the guidance of a senior data engineer next to you.

**Why work at Rotate?**

At Rotate, you’ll join a fast-moving team that’s tackling an endless stream of fascinating problems in an industry that’s essential to the global economy. We build high-impact products and strategies using modern technologies, and we’re committed to tailoring your personal and professional growth as we scale. Our performance management and learning programs are all about helping you grow, with coaching and mentorship on a daily basis.

In addition to excellent compensation, you’ll get to:

* **Build things that matter.** Solve complex problems in a critical industry. Advise clients on their most fundamental strategic questions, or partner with airlines to co-develop data-driven SaaS products with the latest technology stack. Drive efficiency and sustainability in global supply chains.
* **Write your own story.** Feel like an entrepreneur within a well-funded company and established team. Help us build Rotate and share in our joint success. Partner with us to tailor your development and career ambition.
* **Live unforgettable experiences.** Get exposed to different cultures, go on unforgettable offsites, experience the highs and lows of scale-up life…and if you’re keen, travel the world and eat sushi in Tokyo!

**Your qualifications**

We’re looking for curious, motivated self‑starters who are eager to learn, experiment, and grow into the role of a data engineer. You enjoy solving problems, asking questions, and taking ownership of your work, even if you’re still figuring things out. You thrive in a supportive, flexible environment where you can make a real impact while developing your skills.

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

* A completed university in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Econometrics, Aerospace engineering or a related field
* Some hands‑on experience with **Python**, through career, internships, projects, coursework, or personal experiments
* A basic understanding of data pipelines, APIs, or distributed systems, and the motivation to deepen your knowledge
* **Interest in DevOps concepts** such as CI/CD, cloud platforms, or containerization (experience is a plus, not a requirement)
* A **proactive, solutions‑oriented** mindset: you like breaking down problems and trying things out
* **Strong communication skills:** you can explain your thinking and enjoy collaborating with both technical and business colleagues
* **Fluency in English** (additional languages are a bonus)

* Curiosity about AWS, Kubernetes, monitoring, or data processing workflows, with the willingness to learn these on the job
* Genuine interest in the aviation industry

**Where is Rotate located?**

We are based in Utrecht, within 2 minute walking distance from Central Station. We find value in being together to collaborate, but we offer flexibility to accommodate different ways of working.

**Contact us!**

If you’re still reading and are excited about this role, we welcome your application even if you think you don’t meet all the requirements. We understand that no candidate is perfect, and would love to hear your story. We are looking forward to hearing from you via careers@letsrotate.com.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**Ready for a challenge?**
--------------------------

Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We’re a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience.

Whether it’s a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe.

**About this role**
-------------------

We are seeking an enthusiastic Data Engineer to join our Partner and Sales data team. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in designing scalable solutions for the efficient use of big data within Google Cloud Platform (GCP) projects. Together with the team, you will be responsible for building and optimizing robust data pipelines and further scaling the measurement datasets to turn them into actionable insights - including pipelines that serve as the foundation for machine learning and AI use cases.

* ***Please note that this position is located in Amsterdam (3 days a week from our Amsterdam office and 2 days working from home)***

**These are some of the key components to the position:**
---------------------------------------------------------

  

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and a semantic layer on GCP, leveraging Airflow for orchestration and dbt for transformation and modeling.
* Design and implement dimensional data models (star and snowflake schemas) to organize and optimize data for analysis and reporting.
* Build AI-ready data pipelines and feature datasets supporting machine learning and analytical AI use cases.
* Leverage advanced SQL and Python to transform, optimize, and analyze large datasets across partner and sales domains.
* Ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across the stack — operating within and contributing to established DQ frameworks, SLAs, and alerting systems.
* Collaborate closely with analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into robust data solutions.

**What will you bring to the team?**
------------------------------------

  

* Experience in data engineering or similar roles, with a track record of delivering production-grade data pipelines.
* Strong SQL and data modelling skills, including dimensional modelling concepts, paired with Python proficiency for building and automating data workflows.
* Hands-on experience with tools such as Airflow and dbt, and comfort with Git and CI/CD principles.
* Solid knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and its data-native services.
* Familiarity with AI/LLM-powered developer tooling and an interest in building data foundations that enable AI and ML use cases.
* A collaborative, solutions-oriented mindset with strong communication skills and a sharp eye for data reliability.

**At JET, this is how we play**
-------------------------------

Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment.

Being the best at what we do isn’t just about delivering on our strategy. It's a competition for something incredibly valuable – our customers' choice. Every time a customer decides where to order, they're picking a side.

At the heart of the JET Customer League are our values and behaviours. They guide every interaction, every decision, every innovation. These are the actions we need to perform consistently and brilliantly, to surpass the competition and earn our customers’ loyalty, again and again.

Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth, helping one another to succeed and celebrating wins. By truly living our values and embodying our behaviours, we’re building a customer-first culture which enables us to stay one step ahead of the competition.

**Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging**
------------------------------------

No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day.

**What else are we delivering?**
--------------------------------

Want to know more about our JETers, culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people's stories, blogs, podcasts and more JET journeys.

**Are you ready to join the team? Apply now!**
----------------------------------------------

jobs.title: Medior Data Analist
jobs.description:
Finterface digitaliseert voorraad- en debiteurenfinanciering voor banken en financiers. Ons SaaS platform helpt risico’s beter te beheersen, processen te versnellen en beslissingen te baseren op realtime bedrijfsdata. Zo ondersteunen we financiers bij betrouwbare kredietverlening en geven we bedrijven duidelijkheid over hun financieringsruimte.

Als Data Analist werk je mee aan het platform dat banken en financiers nu al helpt om kredietrisico's scherper in te schatten en financieringsbeslissingen sneller te nemen.

**Jouw rol**

Je werkt op het snijvlak van data, finance en IT. Jouw analyses en rapportages vormen de basis voor risicobeoordeling en financieringsbeslissingen van onze klanten: banken in Europa. Daarbij heb je contact met zowel banken als leningnemers, en schakel je met stakeholders variërend van IT-specialisten en finance teams tot management en CFO's, dat maakt de rol veelzijdig en interessant.

Je begint als analist, maar er is ruimte om door te groeien naar de rol van eerste aanspreekpunt en eindverantwoordelijke voor jouw bank. Daarvoor is het belangrijk dat je energie krijgt van klantcontact en dat graag opzoekt.

**Wat je gaat doen**

* Data verkrijgen, analyseren en valideren om betrouwbare inzichten te leveren.
* Werken met SQL om data te controleren, structureren en inzichtelijk te maken.
* Meebouwen aan rapportages voor risk- en financieringsbeslissingen.
* Samenwerken met banken en financiers als inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt.
* Afstemmen met klanten over data, processen en rapportages.
* Asset-Based Lending werkt en hoe data daarin het verschil maakt.

**Wie wij zoeken**

* WO/HBO-diploma
* Affiniteit met IT en financiële processen is een must
* Interesse in financiële processen en risicobeoordeling
* 2 tot 7 jaar ervaring in soortgelijke rol
* Ervaring met SQL
* Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels
* Analytisch en leergierig, met de ambitie om door te groeien naar meer klantverantwoordelijkheid
* Je haalt energie uit klantcontact en durft die rol steeds meer naar je toe te trekken

**Waarom Finterface?**

* Doorgroei die concreet is: je groeit toe naar de rol van eindverantwoordelijke voor je eigen bankrelaties, ondersteund door trainingen en begeleiding die daar specifiek op gericht zijn.
* Direct contact met toonaangevende banken en corporates.
* Hybride werkcultuur: Flexibiliteit om deels remote te werken, gecombineerd met inspirerende teamdagen die samenwerking en scherp inzicht stimuleren.
* Een open team waarin je input telt en vragen stellen wordt aangemoedigd.
* Internationale ambitie: Je maakt deel uit van een bedrijf dat actief is in Nederland, UK en binnenkort heel Europa.
* Purpose-driven: We bouwen niet alleen software, maar ook vertrouwen en duurzame oplossingen voor de financiële wereld

Wil jij jouw analytische skills inzetten in een fintechomgeving waar leren, verantwoordelijkheid en klantencontact samenkomen? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

*Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.*

Soort dienstverband: Fulltime, Parttime, Uitzicht op vast

Salaris: €3.750,00 - €4.250,00 per maand

Arbeidsvoorwaarden:

* Pensioen
* Reiskostenvergoeding

Opleiding:

* HBO (Vereist)

Taal:

* Nederlands (Vereist)

Toestemming om in Nederland te werken:

* Nederland (Vereist)

Werklocatie: Hybride werken in 4814 Breda

jobs.title: Data Engineer
Data Engineer Zorg
Machine Learning Platform Engineer I
jobs.description:
**Your Opportunity**

We are looking for a Machine Learning Platform Engineer to join Mollie's Machine Learning Platform team, sitting within our broader Data Domain. Our ML Platform empowers Machine Learning Scientists to develop and deploy custom ML solutions at scale across Mollie, serving domains including Risk & Fraud, Payments, Merchant Experience, Financial Services, Go-to-Market, and more. As the central team responsible for Mollie's Machine Learning Platform, we own the maintenance and continuous enhancement of the platform, ensuring it remains reliable, scalable, and fit for production-grade workloads. We work closely with domain teams to bring custom ML models into products, bridging the gap between research and real-world impact, while also designing and developing custom GenAI tooling and platforms for both internal employees and Mollie's customers.

This is a hands-on role where you will spend the majority of your time writing Python and Terraform alongside a team of skilled ML Platform Engineers. Based at Mollie's Lisbon Hub, you will be part of a geographically distributed team spanning Amsterdam and Lisbon, working in a collaborative environment that embraces both remote and hybrid ways of working.

**What you’ll be doing**

As an ML Platform Engineer, you will:

* Collaborate closely with ML Platform Engineers, Machine Learning Scientists, and engineers across Mollie's domain teams to deliver scalable Machine Learning solutions
* Deploy and operationalize ML models to production in partnership with Machine Learning Scientists, bridging the gap between experimentation and real-world impact
* Enhance and maintain our cloud-based ML Platform on GCP, writing production-grade Python and Terraform daily
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for ML model training and inference, ensuring reliable and automated workflows across environments
* Deploy, manage, and scale model serving endpoints on Kubernetes, ensuring low-latency, high-availability inference for production workloads
* Assist in extending, developing, and hosting custom and open-source AI tooling ; enabling teams to rapidly build and deploy AI-powered solutions.
* Champion MLOps best practices, implementing standards around model versioning, experiment tracking, data validation, and automated retraining
* Ensure platform reliability by setting up observability, monitoring, and alerting for both infrastructure and deployed models
* Maintain and enhance open-source AI tooling hosted at Mollie (such as LiteLLM and LibreChat), and further support and expand our generative AI capabilities.

**What you'll bring**

* 1+ year of experience deploying and maintaining ML models in production
* Good understanding of MLOps principles, including matters such as experiment tracking, reproducibility, pipeline automation, model versioning, and monitoring in production
* Strong hands-on Python programming skills, with proficiency across common ML and data libraries such as scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, XGBoost, LightGBM, and MLflow
* Familiarity with at a major cloud platform, preferably GCP
* Experience with containerization (Docker), with preferred familiarity in container orchestration tools such as Kubernetes and Kubeflow.
* Strong context-switching ability with sharp attention to detail, adapting quickly to shifting priorities
* Preferably familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools such as Terraform
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for ML workflows

**Grow your way**

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy. If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you.

**AI at Mollie**

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
**Bouw mee aan een van de nieuwste AI-initiatieven van Technische Unie**

Technische Unie bouwt aan de dienstverlening van de toekomst voor klanten én medewerkers. Met behulp van data, digital en AI willen we slimmer werken, klanten relevanter bedienen en nieuwe commerciële kansen benutten. Daarom zoeken we een AI Engineer die onderdeel wordt van een nieuw team en vanaf de start meebouwt aan slimme oplossingen met zichtbare impact op onze organisatie.

**Dit ga je doen**
------------------

Je werkt op het snijvlak van business en technologie. Samen met collega's uit sales, marketing, data en IT vertaal je commerciële kansen en klantbehoeften naar slimme AI-oplossingen die daadwerkelijk gebruikt worden.

Je gaat onder andere:

* AI-agents en toepassingen ontwikkelen die klantactivatie, verkoop en service ondersteunen;
* AI inzetten om grote groepen klanten relevanter en persoonlijker te bedienen en activeren, zonder dat daarvoor evenredig meer handmatig werk nodig is;
* klant-, product-, interactie- en commerciële data verbinden om next-best-actions en commerciële kansen slimmer te ondersteunen;
* experimenten en prototypes snel vertalen naar oplossingen die daadwerkelijk in de praktijk gebruikt kunnen worden;
* gebruik en resultaat meten en succesvolle toepassingen continu verbeteren en opschalen;
* samenwerken met Data & IT en andere specialisten om toepassingen betrouwbaar, veilig en beheersbaar te realiseren.

**Jouw team en impact**

Je stapt in een nieuw AI-team dat volop in ontwikkeling is. Samen met collega's uit de business, data en IT bouw je aan AI-oplossingen die direct waarde toevoegen voor collega's én klanten.

Je krijgt veel ruimte om kansen zelf te ontdekken, processen slimmer te maken en ideeën om te zetten in toepassingen die daadwerkelijk worden gebruikt. Zo draag je zichtbaar bij aan de verdere groei van AI binnen Technische Unie.

**Wij bieden**
--------------

Jouw ontwikkeling, gezondheid en veiligheid staan centraal. Als Top Employer bieden we veel goede arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals:

* Geniet van 40 verlofdagen (vakantie- én ATV-dagen op fulltime basis) én de optie om dagen te kopen of verkopen
* Variabele beloning en solide pensioenregeling
* Blijf vitaal met een vitaliteitsbudget, thuiswerkregeling, sportschoolkorting en gezondheidschecks
* Altijd blijven groeien met ons brede trainings- en opleidingsaanbod

**Heb jij het in je?**
----------------------

Lef, durf en aanpassingsvermogen! Dat is de mentaliteit waarmee onze collega’s het verschil maken. Of je nu net begint of al wat ervaring meebrengt, bij Technische Unie krijg je de ruimte om te ontwikkelen op jouw manier.

Iedereen brengt iets unieks mee. Juist die mix van verschillen maakt ons sterker als team. We geloven in een werksfeer waarin je jezelf kunt zijn, kunt groeien en elke dag iets nieuws kunt ontdekken.

Met meer dan 2.000 collega’s bouwen we dagelijks aan een slimmer, duurzamer Nederland. We helpen onze klanten vooruit met een breed aanbod technische producten, diensten en een krachtige online omgeving die behoort tot de grootste B2B-platforms van Nederland. Maar het echte verschil maken we met elkaar, met mensen die energie, ideeën en lef meebrengen. Heb jij het in je?

**Dit breng je mee**
--------------------

Je krijgt energie van het bouwen van slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk gebruikt worden. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar wat er met AI mogelijk is, maar begint altijd bij de vraag van de gebruiker of de business.

Daarnaast:

* heb je hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau;
* heb je ervaring met softwareontwikkeling, data, AI of automatisering;
* weet je businessvraagstukken te vertalen naar praktische en werkende oplossingen;
* ben je bekend met API's, data, cloudomgevingen en AI-toepassingen;
* heb je ervaring met generatieve AI, bijvoorbeeld AI-agents, RAG, prompt engineering, tool calling en API-integraties;
* werk je graag samen met collega's uit verschillende disciplines;
* ben je ondernemend, pragmatisch en niet bang om nieuwe dingen uit te proberen.

Ervaring met Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Azure, CRM, e-commerce of productdata is mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste. Nederlands spreken is belangrijk, omdat je veel samenwerkt met collega's binnen de business

jobs.title: Software Developer with AI
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Arηs Group, Part of Accenture, specializes in the management of complex public sector IT projects, including systems integration, informatics and analytics, solution implementation and program management. Our team helps lead clients through digital and information systems design, bringing expertise in a variety of areas ranging from software development, data science and security management to machine learning, cloud, and mobile development. Arηs Group was acquired by Accenture in July 2024.

 **Job Description**

As a Software Developer, you will perform the following tasks/services:

* Perform the design, implementation, and optimization of scalable AI based software solutions indicated by the client.
* Research, review, test and suggest for selection by the client of open source AI models to perform specific data processing tasks.
* Integrate AI models indicated by the client in modular components and build pipelines combining multiple AI based modules.
* Implement features and fixes in existing software products using Python as programming language.
* Compile relevant technical documentation, recording technical decisions, and provide usage instructions so others can understand and work with the software concerned.
* Perform unit and integration tests, finding and fixing defects, and verifying that the software behaves as intended.
* Perform any other relevant task as requested.

  
**Qualifications**

Mandatory:

* Bachelor's degree
* English language proficiency at minimum B2 level
* At least 6 years of experience in the IT field
* A minimum of 2 years of experience in ICT development of AI based software solutions.
* Participation in a minimum of 1 project integrating AI models.
* Participation in a minimum of 1 project involving the integration of AI models in modular components and/or building pipelines combining multiple AI based modules.
* A minimum of 2 years of experience with: writing clean, efficient, and scalable code using Python as programming languages.
* Good working knowledge of Python.
* Good knowledge of AI and machine learning fundamentals.
* Good knowledge of software architecture, APIs, microservices, and Docker.
* Good knowledge of software development methodologies (e.g. AGILE).

Desirable:

* Experience with: performing design, implementation, and optimization of scalable AI based software solutions.
* A minimum of 1 year of experience with: building test sets and automated evaluations to measure system performance and model accuracy, detecting regressions after model or prompting changes, and complementing standard unit and integration tests.
* Good knowledge of basic statistics and evaluation metrics (precision, recall, F1, error rates).
* Ability to participate in multi-lingual meetings, ease of communication.
* Capability of integration in an international/multi-cultural environment.
* Ability to cope with fast changing technologies used in application developments.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer (React Native / Svelte)
jobs.description:
Mobile & frontend focus · Full-time (40 hours) · Amsterdam · Hybrid

**Why AIAIAI**

AI is changing how everyone works, but most people outside the tech bubble haven't found a way to use it yet. AIAIAI helps everyday employees use AI in a way that feels natural to them, without asking them to change how they work. Our users are late adopters, so the product has to just work.

We're a small, experienced team that has built and scaled SaaS products before. Engineers here own features from start to finish, and AI does a lot of the typing.

**The role**

You'll own our mobile app and help build our web platform. You'll take a feature from a rough idea to the app stores, and make small backend changes when a feature needs them.

We don't want someone who just uses AI to autocomplete. We want a conductor who ships in a day what used to take a week.

Our stack: React Native (Expo, Expo Router, NativeWind, Reanimated, TanStack Query), SvelteKit + Tailwind, TypeScript throughout, Python and Go services, Postgres, OpenAPI-generated clients, Sentry, LiveKit and ElevenLabs for voice.

**Must-haves**

* 3+ years shipping production TypeScript and React. Fewer is fine if you have a master's in computer science or a related field.
* At least one React Native app shipped to both app stores, ideally with Expo.
* Strong with server state (TanStack Query), offline caching, and typed API clients.
* Comfortable with Tailwind-style styling.
* Able to work in SvelteKit within weeks, coming from any modern web framework.
* Can make small backend changes in Python or Go, and knows Postgres.
* Builds for real conditions: cheap Android phones, slow networks, proper loading and error states.

**Nice-to-haves**

* Real-time features: voice, WebRTC/LiveKit, or streaming responses.
* Experience with the messy parts of mobile: EAS builds, over-the-air updates, push notifications, deep links, store reviews.
* Translations (Lingui or similar), shared design systems, debugging from Sentry data.

**How you work with AI**

* You run several AI agents in parallel and spend your time reviewing, not typing.
* You break features into well-scoped briefs an agent can finish on its own.
* You catch AI mistakes: made-up APIs, quiet regressions, code that looks right but isn't.
* You make agents prove their work with tests instead of trusting them.
* You've built your own setup: custom instructions, project memory, MCP tools, or reusable skills.
* You know which model to use for which job, and when to write it by hand.
* You've built AI features for end users (streaming, voice, tool calling) and care how non-tech people experience them.

**How you work with people**

* You work with design and product to sharpen a vague ticket, and spot improvements as you build.
* You ship small and often, and throw away your own code without ego.
* You finish the boring last 10%.
* You explain your work clearly to non-engineers.

Missing a few items on the stack list? Apply anyway. How you think and ship matters more than any one framework.

**What we offer**

* Ownership: your work ships to real users within days, not quarters.
* AI tools on us: we pay for your Claude, Codex and Grok subscriptions.
* Hybrid: at least 1 day a week in our office on the canals of Amsterdam.
* Salary: €50,000–€60,000 all-in, depending on experience.
* Visa: we can't offer sponsorship at this time.

**How to apply**

Apply with your CV. Optionally, add a link to an app you've shipped and tell us about one feature you shipped much faster with AI agents, and what you had to fix along the way.

**Interview stages**

* Intro (30 min, online): get to know each other.
* System design (60 min, online): design a feature with us, from the app down to the API.
* Peer coding (60 min, in our office): build something together with your usual AI tools. We watch how you brief, check and throw away bad output, not just the final code.

Salaris: €50.000,00 - €60.000,00 per jaar

Toestemming om in Nederland te werken:

jobs.title: Full-stack developer
jobs.description:
WeTicket ist eine All-in-one-Lösung für Online-Ticketing, die Veranstaltern hilft zu wachsen und ihre Kosten deutlich zu senken.

Das Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis von Ticketsystemen ist aus dem Gleichgewicht geraten. Es ist keine Ausnahme, dass Veranstalter Gebühren von bis zu **10%** zahlen, die genau das Budget auffressen, mit dem sie ihren Gästen das beste Erlebnis bieten wollen.

Wir suchen **Full-Stack-Engineers**, die als Teil des Gründungsteams die Zukunft des Ticketings mitgestalten: ein gutes Kundenerlebnis zu einem fairen Preis.

#### **Das WeTicket-Angebot**

* Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt.
* Ein großzügiges Beteiligungspaket.
* Vollzeit, teils in unserem Büro im Zentrum von Amsterdam, mit der Möglichkeit, einige Tage pro Woche remote zu arbeiten. **Derzeit können wir weder Visa noch einen Umzug unterstützen.**
* Ein Team, das schnell iteriert und ausliefert und in dem Fehler erlaubt sind.

#### **Wen wir suchen**

Ein guter Engineer zu sein hängt nicht allein von Erfahrung mit bestimmten Frameworks, vom Alter oder von früheren Titeln ab. Wenn Sie unsicher sind, ob Sie passen, schicken Sie uns gerne Ihre Fragen.

* Nachweisliche Erfahrung als Software Engineer in einem Produktteam.
* Erfahrung mit mindestens einem der folgenden Bereiche: **C#** (**.NET**), **PostgreSQL**, **TypeScript**, **React**. Es handelt sich um eine Full-Stack-Rolle, ein klarer Schwerpunkt im Back- oder Frontend ist aber völlig in Ordnung.
* Sehr gutes Englisch und die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Konzepte klar zu vermitteln.
* Gute Energie. Lassen Sie uns herausfinden, ob unsere Werte, Ziele und unsere Mission zusammenpassen.

#### **Technik**

* Unser Backend basiert auf einem **RESTful-API**-Server mit **C#** und **.NET**. Die Daten liegen in **PostgreSQL**.
* Unsere Frontends sind mit **Next.js** und **Redux** gebaut.
* Wir haben eine **React Native**-App, mit der Veranstalter Tickets vor Ort scannen.
* Wir sind noch am Anfang. Sie übernehmen Verantwortung für Teile unserer Infrastruktur und entscheiden mit, wie der Tech-Stack von WeTicket in Zukunft aussieht.

#### **Aufgaben**

* Teil des Gründungsteams sein, mit der Möglichkeit, mit der Zeit ein eigenes Team aufzubauen.
* Kernfunktionen unseres Produkts im Front- und Backend verantworten und entwickeln.
* Mit unserem Produkt- und Customer-Success-Team neue Funktionen konzipieren und umsetzen, die Wirkung haben.
* Unsere Codebasis pflegen und für optimale Performance verbessern, Code Reviews durchführen, debuggen und testen.

#### **Bewerbung**

Schreiben Sie uns an nick@weticket.com.

Nehmen Sie alles auf, was uns hilft, Ihren Hintergrund und Ihre Erfolge zu verstehen.

Besonders freuen wir uns über Hinweise auf Projekte, auf die Sie stolz sind, mit einer kurzen Erklärung, was das Projekt macht. Links zu GitHub sind immer nützlich. Lebensläufe helfen, sagen für sich genommen aber wenig aus.

* **️ Bewerbungsprozess**

* Wir sprechen 30 Minuten per Telefon oder bei einem Kaffee und schauen, ob Werte und Energie passen. Dabei reden wir darüber, was uns an WeTicket und an Technologie begeistert.

* Ein Gespräch vor Ort, bei dem Sie das Team kennenlernen und uns mehr über Ihre Arbeitsweise erzählen.

* Wenn es passt, machen wir Ihnen ein Angebot.

jobs.title: Medior Data Engineer Dienstregeling (Dutch speaking only)
jobs.description:
**Daarom wil je als Medior Data Engineer bij NS werken**
--------------------------------------------------------

* Je bouwt de data waarop NS complexe keuzes rond de dienstregeling, materieel, personeel en energie kan onderbouwen.
* Je werkt aan een flexibel datafundament waarin planningsdata uit verschillende momenten betrouwbaar samenkomt. Technische diepgang waarmee je bijdraagt aan de treindienst van de toekomst.
* Je krijgt ruimte om je te ontwikkelen in het dienstregelingsdomein en te werken met de nieuwste technologie, terwijl je vanaf het begin verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor kwaliteit, testen en productie.

Jouke: "Je leert hier ontzettend snel, omdat je met moderne cloud-technologie werkt binnen een team dat elkaar scherp houdt. De uitdaging zit 'm in de complexiteit van de keten: alles hangt met alles samen, dus je moet goed kunnen schakelen tussen techniek en de business erachter."

**Dit ga je doen als Medior Data Engineer Dienstregeling**
----------------------------------------------------------

Als Medior Data Engineer maak je planningsdata toegankelijk en betrouwbaar. Jouw data-objecten vormen de basis waarop andere BI-teams informatieproducten en analyses bouwen. Daarmee help je NS om de dienstregeling steeds beter af te stemmen op de wensen van reizigers, eisen van de overheid en de beschikbaarheid van personeel, materieel en energie.

Je werkt end-to-end: van refinement tot bronontsluiting , testen, code review en productie. Je hoeft nog niet iedere complexe oplossing zelfstandig te beheersen. Wel neem je medior ervaring mee, werk je graag hands-on en wil je blijven leren.

Dankzij jouw gevoel voor kwaliteit en eigenaarschap ben jij van waarde bij het:

* bouwen van robuuste Snowflake-code met controles op verwerking, foutafhandeling en datakwaliteit;
* maken en onderhouden van een Datavault 2.0
* reviewen en testen van eigen code en die van collega’s, met aandacht voor risico en afbreukrisico;
* zichtbaar maken van afhankelijkheden en samen met de Product Owner prioriteren over de hele dataketen;
* automatiseren van deployments, werken met versiebeheer en in productie nemen van oplossingen;
* ontsluiten van databronnen in de Azure cloud en opwerken van data met Databricks;
* initiëren en implementeren van verbeteringen, of deze gericht overdragen aan een ander team.

**Hier ga je werken**
---------------------

Je werkt op loopafstand van Utrecht Centraal bij Data, Innovatie & Analyse. Binnen cluster Prestatieregie helpt jouw team NS om datagedreven te sturen op een steeds betere dienstregeling.

Je komt in een multidisciplinair Scrum-team met Data Engineers, een informatieanalist, Product Owner en Scrum Master. Het team werkt hard, viert successen en houdt elkaar inhoudelijk scherp. Je krijgt ervaren collega’s om van te leren én ruimte om zelf een duidelijke visie in te brengen.

Bij NS vinden we diversiteit en inclusie belangrijk. Verschillende perspectieven maken onze samenwerking en oplossingen beter. Wat jouw achtergrond, leeftijd, gender, culturele identiteit, beperking of levensovertuiging ook is: we zijn vooral benieuwd naar jouw vakmanschap, motivatie en kijk op deze functie.

**Dit zijn de functie-eisen**
-----------------------------

We zoeken geen kandidaat die ieder onderdeel al volledig beheerst. Herken je jezelf in de kern van het profiel en wil je je verder ontwikkelen? Dan nodigen we je uit om te reageren.

* Je werkt en denkt op hbo- of wo-niveau. Dit kan blijken uit opleiding, werkervaring of een combinatie daarvan.
* Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring als Data Engineer in een ETL-, BI- of datawarehouseomgeving en hebt zelfstandig datapipelines gebouwd.
* Je hebt praktische ervaring met Snowflake en met het verwerken van grote of complexe datavolumes.
* Je hebt ervaring met Datavault 2.0.
* Je hebt gewerkt in een Agile, Scrum, DevOps- of Kanbanomgeving en kent versiebeheer, deployment automation, testen en productiegang.
* Je maakt kwaliteit zichtbaar in je werk: je bouwt controles in, reviewt code en weegt risico’s af in plaats van alleen nieuwe functionaliteit op te leveren.
* Je bent kritisch, neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor sprintresultaten en je bent een finisher zodat alles netjes achterblijft voor de volgende feature. Je bent bereid om te designen, plannen, bouwen, testen, deployen en documenteren

Ervaring met Databricks is mooi meegenomen. Mis je kennis van een van deze tools, maar heb je een sterke basis en leer je snel? Ook dan horen we graag van je.

Bij NS vinden we het belangrijk dat we elkaar durven aanspreken en ons kunnen uitspreken. Voor deze functie betekent dit dat je verantwoordelijkheid neemt, actief samenwerkt en verbeteringen niet laat liggen.

**Dit zijn de arbeidsvoorwaarden**
----------------------------------

Werken bij NS betekent dat jij hét verschil kunt maken in de wereld van duurzame mobiliteit. Je maakt deel uit van een organisatie die midden in de maatschappij staat en Nederland in beweging brengt. Maar als 1 van de grootste werkgevers van Nederland hebben we je zoveel meer te bieden. Voor deze functie is dit onder andere:

* Een salaris tussen € 3.743,- en € 6.491,- bruto per maand (schaal 60) (o.b.v. 36-urige werkweek), afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.
* Een 36- urige werkweek.
* 144 uur wettelijk verlof (o.b.v. een fulltime dienstverband) + extra verlof afhankelijk van leeftijd (minimaal een week).
* Een professionele, output-gestuurde werkomgeving waar gewerkt wordt volgens ‘het nieuwe werken’. Vrijheid en eigen inbreng staan daarbij centraal.
* De mogelijkheid om 3 christelijke feestdagen om te ruilen voor 3 niet-christelijke feestdagen.
* 3% eindejaarsuitkering, 8% vakantietoeslag en een uitstekende pensioenregeling.
* Je treinreizen in de 2e klas zijn gratis; in de 1e klas reizen kan tegen een kleine eigen bijdrage.
* Je gezin reist gratis in de daluren.
* Korting op Europese treinreizen zodra je 1 jaar bij NS werkt.
* De mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken en flexibele werktijden (in overleg).
* Professionel

jobs.title: Machine Learning Platform Engineer I
jobs.description:
**Your Opportunity**

We are looking for a Machine Learning Platform Engineer to join Mollie's Machine Learning Platform team, sitting within our broader Data Domain. Our ML Platform empowers Machine Learning Scientists to develop and deploy custom ML solutions at scale across Mollie, serving domains including Risk & Fraud, Payments, Merchant Experience, Financial Services, Go-to-Market, and more. As the central team responsible for Mollie's Machine Learning Platform, we own the maintenance and continuous enhancement of the platform, ensuring it remains reliable, scalable, and fit for production-grade workloads. We work closely with domain teams to bring custom ML models into products, bridging the gap between research and real-world impact, while also designing and developing custom GenAI tooling and platforms for both internal employees and Mollie's customers.

This is a hands-on role where you will spend the majority of your time writing Python and Terraform alongside a team of skilled ML Platform Engineers. Based at Mollie's Lisbon Hub, you will be part of a geographically distributed team spanning Amsterdam and Lisbon, working in a collaborative environment that embraces both remote and hybrid ways of working.

**What you’ll be doing**

As an ML Platform Engineer, you will:

* Collaborate closely with ML Platform Engineers, Machine Learning Scientists, and engineers across Mollie's domain teams to deliver scalable Machine Learning solutions
* Deploy and operationalize ML models to production in partnership with Machine Learning Scientists, bridging the gap between experimentation and real-world impact
* Enhance and maintain our cloud-based ML Platform on GCP, writing production-grade Python and Terraform daily
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for ML model training and inference, ensuring reliable and automated workflows across environments
* Deploy, manage, and scale model serving endpoints on Kubernetes, ensuring low-latency, high-availability inference for production workloads
* Assist in extending, developing, and hosting custom and open-source AI tooling ; enabling teams to rapidly build and deploy AI-powered solutions.
* Champion MLOps best practices, implementing standards around model versioning, experiment tracking, data validation, and automated retraining
* Ensure platform reliability by setting up observability, monitoring, and alerting for both infrastructure and deployed models
* Maintain and enhance open-source AI tooling hosted at Mollie (such as LiteLLM and LibreChat), and further support and expand our generative AI capabilities.

**What you'll bring**

* 1+ year of experience deploying and maintaining ML models in production
* Good understanding of MLOps principles, including matters such as experiment tracking, reproducibility, pipeline automation, model versioning, and monitoring in production
* Strong hands-on Python programming skills, with proficiency across common ML and data libraries such as scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, XGBoost, LightGBM, and MLflow
* Familiarity with at a major cloud platform, preferably GCP
* Experience with containerization (Docker), with preferred familiarity in container orchestration tools such as Kubernetes and Kubeflow.
* Strong context-switching ability with sharp attention to detail, adapting quickly to shifting priorities
* Preferably familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools such as Terraform
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for ML workflows

**Grow your way**

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy. If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you.

**AI at Mollie**

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

new_jobs.title: Junior Data Engineer

**As Junior Data Engineer, you’ll help build data products for the air‑cargo logistics industry by turning your academic knowledge into practical solutions, working closely with data engineers, software engineers, analysts, and consultants to solve real operational challenges.**

**Who we are**

We are Rotate. We help key players across the global air cargo and logistics industry make better commercial and strategic decisions. We provide cloud-based software and analytics, world-leading market data, and data-driven strategy consulting. Our clients include top-tier airlines, airports, freight forwarders, governments, shippers, investors, and other industry stakeholders.

Founded in 2022 by a core team of former aviation strategy consultants, Rotate has grown rapidly. We now have offices in the Netherlands and Malaysia and a diverse team of around 50 professionals, including strategy consultants, data scientists, software developers, and data engineers. Demand for our work continues to grow strongly, and we are therefore looking for talented data engineers to strengthen our team.

**What you’ll do**

Rotate provides a online SaaS platform containing 3 main products, each of these products is developed and maintained by a core team with a mixed skillset. As a junior data engineer you will join a product team which is a collection of data engineers, software developers, customer succes consultants and business people with every skillset that is needed to keep a complex b2b system going. Your tasks are to:

* maintain and improve current data pipelines
* onboard new clients and data sets
* extend and improve the current functionality of the tools
* work with current and new clients to help understand the usage of the tool
* work in a scrum team responsible for keeping a SaaS product going
* understand data and how it effects operations and processing

In the team you will learn the ins and outs of the air cargo industry. Next to domain knowledge you will also work on your own skillset as a data engineer with the guidance of a senior data engineer next to you.

**Why work at Rotate?**

At Rotate, you’ll join a fast-moving team that’s tackling an endless stream of fascinating problems in an industry that’s essential to the global economy. We build high-impact products and strategies using modern technologies, and we’re committed to tailoring your personal and professional growth as we scale. Our performance management and learning programs are all about helping you grow, with coaching and mentorship on a daily basis.

In addition to excellent compensation, you’ll get to:

* **Build things that matter.** Solve complex problems in a critical industry. Advise clients on their most fundamental strategic questions, or partner with airlines to co-develop data-driven SaaS products with the latest technology stack. Drive efficiency and sustainability in global supply chains.
* **Write your own story.** Feel like an entrepreneur within a well-funded company and established team. Help us build Rotate and share in our joint success. Partner with us to tailor your development and career ambition.
* **Live unforgettable experiences.** Get exposed to different cultures, go on unforgettable offsites, experience the highs and lows of scale-up life…and if you’re keen, travel the world and eat sushi in Tokyo!

**Your qualifications**

We’re looking for curious, motivated self‑starters who are eager to learn, experiment, and grow into the role of a data engineer. You enjoy solving problems, asking questions, and taking ownership of your work, even if you’re still figuring things out. You thrive in a supportive, flexible environment where you can make a real impact while developing your skills.

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

* A completed university in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Econometrics, Aerospace engineering or a related field
* Some hands‑on experience with **Python**, through career, internships, projects, coursework, or personal experiments
* A basic understanding of data pipelines, APIs, or distributed systems, and the motivation to deepen your knowledge
* **Interest in DevOps concepts** such as CI/CD, cloud platforms, or containerization (experience is a plus, not a requirement)
* A **proactive, solutions‑oriented** mindset: you like breaking down problems and trying things out
* **Strong communication skills:** you can explain your thinking and enjoy collaborating with both technical and business colleagues
* **Fluency in English** (additional languages are a bonus)

* Curiosity about AWS, Kubernetes, monitoring, or data processing workflows, with the willingness to learn these on the job
* Genuine interest in the aviation industry

**Where is Rotate located?**

We are based in Utrecht, within 2 minute walking distance from Central Station. We find value in being together to collaborate, but we offer flexibility to accommodate different ways of working.

**Contact us!**

If you’re still reading and are excited about this role, we welcome your application even if you think you don’t meet all the requirements. We understand that no candidate is perfect, and would love to hear your story. We are looking forward to hearing from you via careers@letsrotate.com.

new_jobs.title: Medior Data Analist
new_jobs.description:
Finterface digitaliseert voorraad- en debiteurenfinanciering voor banken en financiers. Ons SaaS platform helpt risico’s beter te beheersen, processen te versnellen en beslissingen te baseren op realtime bedrijfsdata. Zo ondersteunen we financiers bij betrouwbare kredietverlening en geven we bedrijven duidelijkheid over hun financieringsruimte.

Als Data Analist werk je mee aan het platform dat banken en financiers nu al helpt om kredietrisico's scherper in te schatten en financieringsbeslissingen sneller te nemen.

**Jouw rol**

Je werkt op het snijvlak van data, finance en IT. Jouw analyses en rapportages vormen de basis voor risicobeoordeling en financieringsbeslissingen van onze klanten: banken in Europa. Daarbij heb je contact met zowel banken als leningnemers, en schakel je met stakeholders variërend van IT-specialisten en finance teams tot management en CFO's, dat maakt de rol veelzijdig en interessant.

Je begint als analist, maar er is ruimte om door te groeien naar de rol van eerste aanspreekpunt en eindverantwoordelijke voor jouw bank. Daarvoor is het belangrijk dat je energie krijgt van klantcontact en dat graag opzoekt.

**Wat je gaat doen**

* Data verkrijgen, analyseren en valideren om betrouwbare inzichten te leveren.
* Werken met SQL om data te controleren, structureren en inzichtelijk te maken.
* Meebouwen aan rapportages voor risk- en financieringsbeslissingen.
* Samenwerken met banken en financiers als inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt.
* Afstemmen met klanten over data, processen en rapportages.
* Asset-Based Lending werkt en hoe data daarin het verschil maakt.

**Wie wij zoeken**

new_jobs.title: Software Developer with AI
new_jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Arηs Group, Part of Accenture, specializes in the management of complex public sector IT projects, including systems integration, informatics and analytics, solution implementation and program management. Our team helps lead clients through digital and information systems design, bringing expertise in a variety of areas ranging from software development, data science and security management to machine learning, cloud, and mobile development. Arηs Group was acquired by Accenture in July 2024.

 **Job Description**

As a Software Developer, you will perform the following tasks/services:

* Perform the design, implementation, and optimization of scalable AI based software solutions indicated by the client.
* Research, review, test and suggest for selection by the client of open source AI models to perform specific data processing tasks.
* Integrate AI models indicated by the client in modular components and build pipelines combining multiple AI based modules.
* Implement features and fixes in existing software products using Python as programming language.
* Compile relevant technical documentation, recording technical decisions, and provide usage instructions so others can understand and work with the software concerned.
* Perform unit and integration tests, finding and fixing defects, and verifying that the software behaves as intended.
* Perform any other relevant task as requested.

  
**Qualifications**

Mandatory:

* Bachelor's degree
* English language proficiency at minimum B2 level
* At least 6 years of experience in the IT field
* A minimum of 2 years of experience in ICT development of AI based software solutions.
* Participation in a minimum of 1 project integrating AI models.
* Participation in a minimum of 1 project involving the integration of AI models in modular components and/or building pipelines combining multiple AI based modules.
* A minimum of 2 years of experience with: writing clean, efficient, and scalable code using Python as programming languages.
* Good working knowledge of Python.
* Good knowledge of AI and machine learning fundamentals.
* Good knowledge of software architecture, APIs, microservices, and Docker.
* Good knowledge of software development methodologies (e.g. AGILE).

Desirable:

* Experience with: performing design, implementation, and optimization of scalable AI based software solutions.
* A minimum of 1 year of experience with: building test sets and automated evaluations to measure system performance and model accuracy, detecting regressions after model or prompting changes, and complementing standard unit and integration tests.
* Good knowledge of basic statistics and evaluation metrics (precision, recall, F1, error rates).
* Ability to participate in multi-lingual meetings, ease of communication.
* Capability of integration in an international/multi-cultural environment.
* Ability to cope with fast changing technologies used in application developments.

new_jobs.title: Medior Data Engineer Dienstregeling (Dutch speaking only)
new_jobs.description:
**Daarom wil je als Medior Data Engineer bij NS werken**
--------------------------------------------------------

* Je bouwt de data waarop NS complexe keuzes rond de dienstregeling, materieel, personeel en energie kan onderbouwen.
* Je werkt aan een flexibel datafundament waarin planningsdata uit verschillende momenten betrouwbaar samenkomt. Technische diepgang waarmee je bijdraagt aan de treindienst van de toekomst.
* Je krijgt ruimte om je te ontwikkelen in het dienstregelingsdomein en te werken met de nieuwste technologie, terwijl je vanaf het begin verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor kwaliteit, testen en productie.

Jouke: "Je leert hier ontzettend snel, omdat je met moderne cloud-technologie werkt binnen een team dat elkaar scherp houdt. De uitdaging zit 'm in de complexiteit van de keten: alles hangt met alles samen, dus je moet goed kunnen schakelen tussen techniek en de business erachter."

**Dit ga je doen als Medior Data Engineer Dienstregeling**
----------------------------------------------------------

Als Medior Data Engineer maak je planningsdata toegankelijk en betrouwbaar. Jouw data-objecten vormen de basis waarop andere BI-teams informatieproducten en analyses bouwen. Daarmee help je NS om de dienstregeling steeds beter af te stemmen op de wensen van reizigers, eisen van de overheid en de beschikbaarheid van personeel, materieel en energie.

Je werkt end-to-end: van refinement tot bronontsluiting , testen, code review en productie. Je hoeft nog niet iedere complexe oplossing zelfstandig te beheersen. Wel neem je medior ervaring mee, werk je graag hands-on en wil je blijven leren.

Dankzij jouw gevoel voor kwaliteit en eigenaarschap ben jij van waarde bij het:

* bouwen van robuuste Snowflake-code met controles op verwerking, foutafhandeling en datakwaliteit;
* maken en onderhouden van een Datavault 2.0
* reviewen en testen van eigen code en die van collega’s, met aandacht voor risico en afbreukrisico;
* zichtbaar maken van afhankelijkheden en samen met de Product Owner prioriteren over de hele dataketen;
* automatiseren van deployments, werken met versiebeheer en in productie nemen van oplossingen;
* ontsluiten van databronnen in de Azure cloud en opwerken van data met Databricks;
* initiëren en implementeren van verbeteringen, of deze gericht overdragen aan een ander team.

**Hier ga je werken**
---------------------

Je werkt op loopafstand van Utrecht Centraal bij Data, Innovatie & Analyse. Binnen cluster Prestatieregie helpt jouw team NS om datagedreven te sturen op een steeds betere dienstregeling.

Je komt in een multidisciplinair Scrum-team met Data Engineers, een informatieanalist, Product Owner en Scrum Master. Het team werkt hard, viert successen en houdt elkaar inhoudelijk scherp. Je krijgt ervaren collega’s om van te leren én ruimte om zelf een duidelijke visie in te brengen.

Bij NS vinden we diversiteit en inclusie belangrijk. Verschillende perspectieven maken onze samenwerking en oplossingen beter. Wat jouw achtergrond, leeftijd, gender, culturele identiteit, beperking of levensovertuiging ook is: we zijn vooral benieuwd naar jouw vakmanschap, motivatie en kijk op deze functie.

**Dit zijn de functie-eisen**
-----------------------------

We zoeken geen kandidaat die ieder onderdeel al volledig beheerst. Herken je jezelf in de kern van het profiel en wil je je verder ontwikkelen? Dan nodigen we je uit om te reageren.

* Je werkt en denkt op hbo- of wo-niveau. Dit kan blijken uit opleiding, werkervaring of een combinatie daarvan.
* Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring als Data Engineer in een ETL-, BI- of datawarehouseomgeving en hebt zelfstandig datapipelines gebouwd.
* Je hebt praktische ervaring met Snowflake en met het verwerken van grote of complexe datavolumes.
* Je hebt ervaring met Datavault 2.0.
* Je hebt gewerkt in een Agile, Scrum, DevOps- of Kanbanomgeving en kent versiebeheer, deployment automation, testen en productiegang.
* Je maakt kwaliteit zichtbaar in je werk: je bouwt controles in, reviewt code en weegt risico’s af in plaats van alleen nieuwe functionaliteit op te leveren.
* Je bent kritisch, neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor sprintresultaten en je bent een finisher zodat alles netjes achterblijft voor de volgende feature. Je bent bereid om te designen, plannen, bouwen, testen, deployen en documenteren

Ervaring met Databricks is mooi meegenomen. Mis je kennis van een van deze tools, maar heb je een sterke basis en leer je snel? Ook dan horen we graag van je.

Bij NS vinden we het belangrijk dat we elkaar durven aanspreken en ons kunnen uitspreken. Voor deze functie betekent dit dat je verantwoordelijkheid neemt, actief samenwerkt en verbeteringen niet laat liggen.

**Dit zijn de arbeidsvoorwaarden**
----------------------------------

Werken bij NS betekent dat jij hét verschil kunt maken in de wereld van duurzame mobiliteit. Je maakt deel uit van een organisatie die midden in de maatschappij staat en Nederland in beweging brengt. Maar als 1 van de grootste werkgevers van Nederland hebben we je zoveel meer te bieden. Voor deze functie is dit onder andere:

* Een salaris tussen € 3.743,- en € 6.491,- bruto per maand (schaal 60) (o.b.v. 36-urige werkweek), afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.
* Een 36- urige werkweek.
* 144 uur wettelijk verlof (o.b.v. een fulltime dienstverband) + extra verlof afhankelijk van leeftijd (minimaal een week).
* Een professionele, output-gestuurde werkomgeving waar gewerkt wordt volgens ‘het nieuwe werken’. Vrijheid en eigen inbreng staan daarbij centraal.
* De mogelijkheid om 3 christelijke feestdagen om te ruilen voor 3 niet-christelijke feestdagen.
* 3% eindejaarsuitkering, 8% vakantietoeslag en een uitstekende pensioenregeling.
* Je treinreizen in de 2e klas zijn gratis; in de 1e klas reizen kan tegen een kleine eigen bijdrage.
* Je gezin reist gratis in de daluren.
* Korting op Europese treinreizen zodra je 1 jaar bij NS werkt.
* De mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken en flexibele werktijden (in overleg).
* Professionel
